cues.welcome: I'm Echo. The ground has a secret. Let's find it together.
cues.water-draw: Pump water out. Watch the street above the thin clay layer.
cues.water-return: Now bring the water back. Will the street come back too?
cues.water-found: The water returned. The squeezed space did not. You found the twist.
cues.street-together: Move both blocks down together. Keep your eye on their shared pipe.
cues.street-uneven: Now make one end sink farther. Watch the connection bend.
cues.street-inspect: Look between the two blocks. Inspect the joining pipe.
cues.street-found: The difference between the ends bends the connection. Not just the size of the drop.
cues.radar-first: Save the first echo. That gives us something to compare with.
cues.radar-repeat: Slide the ground down. Then capture the repeat echo.
cues.radar-compare: Two visits are saved. Reveal the difference and watch the colours appear.
cues.radar-found: You caught movement in the echo. The colours repeat. Try the phase puzzle if you're curious.
cues.evidence-probe: Choose a measured patch. Then find a gap. Can both tell us the ground is still?
cues.evidence-found: No measurement is not the same as no movement. Keep that distinction in your case file.
cues.policy-water: Give the city another water route, or turn down its well. Watch which connection changes.
cues.policy-monitor: Now add monitoring. Changing a cause and checking a result are two different jobs.
cues.policy-found: You changed the route and added a way to check it. Lost ground height does not reset.
cues.dossier: Five discoveries. One trail of evidence. Take your field notes into the real world.
